stories.title: Who was Renee Nicole Good?
stories.summary: We're continuing to learn more about the 37-year-old woman who was shot and killed by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer in Minneapolis on Wednesday.

stories.title: Noem insists that ICE agent who fatally shot woman in Minneapolis did nothing wrong
stories.summary: Protests continue in Minneapolis over the death of a woman shot by an ICE agent. The head of Minnesota's investigative agency says federal officials have blocked it from conducting an investigation.

stories.title: Trump's second term has included a much more muscular foreign policy than his first
stories.summary: President Trump ran as the Peace President, but since taking office has been on a military spree with strikes on Iran, Yemen, Nigeria, Syria and Venezuela -- and threats against others.

stories.title: Senate Republicans deal Trump a rare rebuke with Venezuela war powers vote
stories.summary: In a rare rebuke to President Trump, five Republicans joined with Democrats on Thursday to advance a measure that would require congressional authorization for future military action in Venezuela.

stories.title: Record snowfall in Juneau as Alaska towns have seen an intense start to the winter
stories.summary: In December, Juneau saw record-breaking snow, which collapsed several roofs and sank multiple boats in the harbor. Now, while they're still digging out, the city is bracing for an atmospheric river.

stories.title: Why the A's were denied a trademark to Las Vegas Athletics
stories.summary: The Athletics have suffered a number of setbacks in their quest to relocate to Las Vegas from Oakland. The latest? The U.S. says they can't actually get a trademark for the name Las Vegas Athletics.
